items.title: Тысячи пропалестинских демонстрантов вышли на митинг в Лондоне
items.original_title: Thousands of pro-Palestinian demonstrators rally in London
items.rss_summary:
Several thousand pro-Palestinian protesters marched through central London on Saturday, calling for an end to Israeli strikes on Gaza, three years after Hamas's October 7 attack.  
            Marchers carried placards reading "End the genocide" and "Free Palestine" as they made their way along the route near the British parliament.  
            "We are here today to mark three years of the ongoing genocide in Gaza," Aimee Shalan, director of the Palestine Solidarity Campaign, told AFP.

items.title: Palestinian Mahmoud Abu Hamda wins top photography prize at Bayeux
items.original_title: Palestinian Mahmoud Abu Hamda wins top photography prize at Bayeux
items.rss_summary:
Palestinian freelancer Mahmoud Abu Hamda on Saturday won the photography category in the prestigious Bayeux award for war correspondents for his work from Gaza.  
            As well as the top prize, Hamda, based in the Gaza Strip, also won the Public's Choice award for his reportage "What War leaves behind".  
            He was not at the ceremony in Bayeux, northwest France, but sent a video message to the event.
